summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Rustbelt Revival prototype. Backend 7/7 pytest cases pass (config, cloud save CRUD, upsert, delete, validation). Frontend flows verified end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844: Town HUD renders (resources, level, XP, restoration), Scrap Yard sheet + Collect button accrues and collects scrap correctly (0->1->4 after ~34s wait), Machine Shop starts a component job (machine-active-job visible), Upgrade button rendered, Contracts screen shows 3 cards with refresh + disabled fulfil when insufficient resources, Town Hall shows restoration progress and reset flow (modal + confirm) works and returns state to Level 1. Bottom tab navigation between Town, Contracts, Town Hall all works.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but recommend cleanup.

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow across StyleSheets to silence RN Web console warnings.
Optional: when a job is already active and user taps a recipe again, ensure game-toast is shown (currently no toast appeared during retest; recipe may be silently ignored).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean and small (~112 lines), Mongo _id properly popped from config, endpoints use /api prefix, Pydantic validation on PUT.
All interactive components have testID attributes (comprehensive coverage across town/contracts/hall/BuildingSheet/HudHeader).
No hardcoded URLs found; frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; backend uses MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env vars.
seed_data_creation: TEST_player_{ts} save created and deleted via fixture teardown. In-app reset also invoked via UI (Town Hall reset flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests under /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Frontend uses testIDs like town-screen, hud-header, resource-*, card-scrap-yard, card-machine-shop, building-sheet, collect-scrap-button, recipe-make-component, machine-active-job, upgrade-button, contracts-screen, contract-<id>, contract-refresh-<id>, contract-fulfill-<id>, hall-screen, reset-game-button, reset-confirm-modal, reset-confirm-button, game-toast. Scrap accrues 1/10s at Lv1, so tests waiting for scrap need ~10-35s. Use PUT /api/game/{player_id} to seed a state with high scrap for faster assertions.
